origin.payment_link: {employee} wants to send a payment link. Money movement always needs a person.
origin.post: A public post from Marketing. Public posts always need approval.
origin.review_reply: A review reply from Reputation. Public replies need a person.
origin.bulk: A bulk message from a campaign or recipe. Bulk sends always need approval.
origin.discount: {employee} wants a discount above the limit. That always needs a person.

wizard.outboundHidden: Outbound calling stays off until this market’s compliance profile allows it.
wizard.market: Market applied: {country}. Times in {timezone}, prices in {currency}.
wizard.blockedAutopilot: Autopilot is blocked while a served language is Tier C.
wizard.phoneRequired: Choose how this employee gets a number.
wizard.phoneNumberRequired: Enter the number to forward or port.
wizard.portDocsRequired: Port-in needs ID, a recent bill, and proof of address.
wizard.forwardDocsRequired: Forwarding needs ID and proof you own the number.
wizard.phoneDocsNg: Nigeria: we collect CAC or national ID, and a utility bill when you forward or port. Lead times are shown before you confirm.
wizard.leadTime: {days, plural, =0 {Ready today} one {# business day} other {# business days}}

phoneHints.buy: We issue a Lagos or Abuja number. Lagos is usually ready the same day.
phoneHints.forward: Keep your current line. Calls forward to Deskhand. 1–2 days after proof of ownership.
phoneHints.port: Move the number to us. 7–14 days. ID, latest bill and proof of address required.

phoneLead.forward: Typical lead time: 1–2 business days after documents.
phoneLead.port: Typical lead time: 7–14 business days after NCC/port paperwork.

wizard.flowHint: Greeting, intent, answers, collect details, book, confirm, close. Silence prompts, then voicemail.
wizard.voicemailFallback: If nobody answers the transfer, the caller reaches voicemail.
wizard.speechShort: Answers are shortened for speech from the same knowledge base.
wizard.recordingHint: Recording stays off until the spoken notice is set. Card numbers and IDs are redacted. We never record while payment details are spoken.
wizard.recordingNoticeRequired: Add the spoken notice before recording can turn on.
wizard.recordingRedact: Owner and Admin can listen. Assigned staff hear only their own transfers.
wizard.outboundPreview: When this market allows outbound, you will set calling hours, attempts, caller ID, consent proof, timezone hours, do-not-call screening and in-call opt-out.
wizard.voiceTestHint: This is a test line. Pass means: no invented prices, correct transfer, disclosure spoken, injection refused.
wizard.voiceLatency: Target under 1 second turn latency, clean barge-in, correct transfer.
wizard.voiceRolloutHint: Start in Shadow (a person answers, the AI listens). Then after-hours only, then full coverage.

voiceUseHints.inbound: Answer live calls in business hours.
voiceUseHints.after_hours: Cover nights and Sundays, then hand to voicemail or a person.
voiceUseHints.reminders: Outbound appointment reminders. Hidden until the market allows it.
voiceUseHints.callback: Outbound lead callbacks. P3, consent required.

wizard.cloneBlocked: Cloning a real person’s voice is blocked without verified written consent.
wizard.disclosureAfterCreate: The disclosure line is filled from the market pack after you create the draft.
wizard.whatsappWindow: WhatsApp still has a 24-hour customer-care window. After that, only approved templates send.
wizard.channelOff: {channel} is not connected yet. The employee can be set up, but it cannot send on this channel.
wizard.moneyDefault: Booking and payment links stay on Approve until you earn Autopilot.
wizard.testHint: Pass means: no invented prices, correct handoffs, disclosure shown, and prompt injection refused.
wizard.complianceBlock: Fix blocking compliance items before Suggest, Approve or Autopilot. Shadow can still start.
wizard.rolloutHint: Start in Shadow, then Suggest, Approve, Autopilot. Autopilot is blocked while a served language is Tier C.

templateHints.receptionist: Greet people, answer FAQs and book. Preselected for this pack.
templateHints.sales: Follow up leads and qualify before a person steps in.
templateHints.support: Handle policies, orders and complaints, with a fast handoff.
templateHints.custom: Start from a blank receptionist and change every skill.

chat.template: The industry pack preselects Receptionist and sample answers.
chat.persona: Market, languages and quality tiers are inherited. Disclosure stays on.
chat.channels: Any mix of WhatsApp, web chat and email. Warns if a channel is not connected.
chat.knowledge: Pick collections, fill gaps, add FAQs, and list words the AI must never say.
chat.skills: Turn tools on. Money and bulk actions default to Approve.
chat.rules: Escalation triggers are preloaded. Set a discount cap, handoff person and quiet hours.
chat.test: Chat in the sandbox and run the scripted checks before go-live.
chat.review: One-page summary. The compliance check from section 8 must pass.
chat.live: Staged rollout. Autopilot needs the earned-autonomy threshold.

voice.use: Inbound answering ships first. Outbound stays hidden until the market allows it.
voice.phone: Buy, forward or port a number.
voice.persona: Voice catalog is limited to this market. Cloning a real person is blocked.
voice.flow: Greeting, intent, booking, transfer and voicemail.
voice.knowledge: Same knowledge base as chat, shortened for speech.
voice.recording: Off until the notice is set.
voice.test: Call a test line and run scripted scenarios.
voice.live: Starts as Shadow, then after-hours, then full coverage.
